notes: The author settled this as purely a place to hang out in with no gameplay, which is the index's hangout-to-look-at entry and puts it in Entertainment rather than Party & Casual - the word party here is the theme, not a round-based minigame collection. A small indoor hall sized for a handful of players is the Indoor Venue preset on interior-single: the room is the entire map, so there is no exterior to generate and no transition to link, which keeps this at P0 with no P3. Players do mingle on foot, so this is not a SET. Decided without a user: I dropped the preset's zone-graphics because a deliberately small, simple hall gives high-fidelity streamed clusters nothing to isolate, and the balloons, streamers, presents and cake are set dressing for the image pass rather than option rows - vignette-photo is where the cake-and-balloons corner earns its composition.
